slices.focus: The 90-day cold-chain pilot expands into broader operating practice with a pantry-specific confirmation board, split mixed-temperature loads, and reduced emergency reschedules at three partner sites, though Eric remains cautious about whether adoption will hold under pressure.
slices.summary: The pilot's success metrics (fewer emergency reschedules, cleaner load planning) convince dispatch and warehouse to adopt the confirmation board and split-load rules as routine practice, moving Eric from pilot leader to system steward.
